description: This file defines the UriInterface, an interface specifying methods for working with and manipulating URI components in an immutable fashion, according to RFC 3986, primarily focused on HTTP message use cases.

classes.name: UriInterface
classes.description: Defines the methods for URI manipulation and retrieval in an immutable manner, covering components like scheme, authority, user info, host, port, path, query, and fragment, with methods to create modified copies.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the URI scheme component, normalized to lowercase, or an empty string if none.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Retrieves the authority component, formatted as '[user-info@]host[:port]', or empty if none.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the user information component, in 'username[:password]' format.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Retrieves the host component, normalized to lowercase, or empty if none.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the port component as an integer or null if not specified or default.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves the path component, percent-encoded, support for absolute, rootless, or empty paths.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Retrieves the query string component, percent-encoded, or empty if none.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Retrieves the fragment component, percent-encoded, or empty if none.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified user info, including optional password.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified port or null.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified query string.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified URI fragment.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the full URI, constructed from components.
